content_of_post_to_comment:
Hi everyone, hopefully you all are doing well.

It would be a bit long post, kindly bear with me and help me to take the right decision.

I am 29, female. From a South Asian country. I did my Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry & Biotechnology, graduated back in 2020. I didn't love this , my cg was bad 2.75/4 (~82%). So I was super depressed with my life, still I am. I was just trying to not think about hard time so just wasted time watching YouTube. Untill 2023 I didn't work, later on just did a simple job for 6 months, not related to my major, that too can't consider a real job. Later I gave ielts & came to South Korea in 2024, graduated with an MBA in 2026, February, cgpa 4.08/4.50. But here, without korean language higher level skill can't get an official job . I need job that can sponser my visa.

My family can't support me financially. I want to shift to other country where I can settle down. I am open to go for job visa or student visa. Currently I can only have about $4000.

But I dont know where I should try considering my situation. I want to be in a place where I can support my finances by myself, as well after graduation can get into official job. I wanted to go for Ireland/ Australia but I don't have the finance to go with that.

Please kind people suggest me what should I do? I am open to any other programs that I should look into, helpful in getting pr with values. I know I am at mess, and not seeing any way out. Your valuable comments would be highly appreciated.
comment: Having a 4.08/4.50 MBA after a rough start is actually a different position than you seem to be giving yourself credit for. I’d be careful about jumping into another expensive degree with only $4000 available. Maybe focus first on countries where your MBA plus work experience can realistically lead to a sponsored role, and consider improving Korean enough to get local experience too. A year of relevant work could change your options much more than another student visa.
